sloka: एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी भरतेन महात्मना ।उवाच वचनम् हृष्टा मूढा पण्डितमानिनी ॥२-७२-४७॥
transliteration: evamuktā tu kaikeyī bharatena mahātmanā ।uvāca vacanam hṛṣṭā mūḍhā paṇḍitamāninī ॥2-72-47॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of great Bharata, that foolish woman Kaikeyi thinking herself to be wise, cheerfully said:
